skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the general issues of urbanization and urban development, the differences between urban and rural areas, the role of urban areas in urban development, and the laws of urbanization.
Analyze urbanization as a transformation in economic drivers, spatial expansion, and urban system connectivity, and its role in sustainable urban development.
Evaluate the degree of urbanization, establish a system of urban development indicators, and apply them to specific urban areas.
Develop skills in searching, reading, and synthesizing scientific information from various sources, and analyze the results to understand urbanization and urban development theories.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently, in groups, and actively participate in presentation and debate activities.
Formulate conclusions about urbanization and urban development issues.
Understand the concept of sustainable urban development and its application in urbanization processes.
Develop skills in urban management and apply them to urban development issues.
Calculate the degree of urbanization and apply initial calculations of urban development indices.
Understand the development of the urban system in Vietnam and its five key transitions.
Utilize positive factors and mitigate negative aspects of urbanization, integrating smart city technology to serve urban residents.
